code='''def transform(grid):
    # The 8 grid divides the picture into equal square rooms. A marker colors
    # its complete room-row or room-column; crossings of 2 and 3 become 6.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rs = [i for i in range(h) if all(v == 8 for v in grid[i])]
    cs = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == 8 for i in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + rs + [h]
    cb = [-1] + cs + [w]
    nr, nc = len(rb)-1, len(cb)-1
    rows = [[0]*nc for _ in range(nr)]
    cols = [[0]*nc for _ in range(nr)]
    for r in range(nr):
        for c in range(nc):
            for i in range(rb[r]+1, rb[r+1]):
                for j in range(cb[c]+1, cb[c+1]):
                    if grid[i][j] in (2,3):
                        rows[r][c] = grid[i][j]
                        cols[r][c] = grid[i][j]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(nr):
        for c in range(nc):
            color = 6 if (any(cols[x][c] == 2 for x in range(nr)) and any(rows[r][y] == 3 for y in range(nc))) else (2 if any(cols[x][c] == 2 for x in range(nr)) else (3 if any(rows[r][y] == 3 for y in range(nc)) else 0))
            if color:
                for i in range(rb[r]+1, rb[r+1]):
                    for j in range(cb[c]+1, cb[c+1]): out[i][j] = color
    return out
'''
